meta.name: git-master
meta.description: MUST USE for ANY git operations. Atomic commits, rebase/squash, history search (blame, bisect, log -S). STRONGLY RECOMMENDED: Use with task(category='quick', load_skills=['git-master'], ...) to save context. Triggers: 'commit', 'rebase', 'squash', 'who wrote', 'when was X added', 'find the commit that'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 执行 git 提交、整理提交记录与搜索历史
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果管理代码提交、整理提交记录或追溯历史修改是你的日常。
copy.tagline_en: Commit code, organize commit history, and search past changes
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you often commit code, organize commit history, or search past changes.

howto.what: 处理 git 操作：先输出仓库提交风格检测，再按目录和关注点把改动拆成多个原子提交（3 个以上文件必须拆），也能重写分支历史（rebase/squash）和查某段改动的出处。
howto.when: 当你说「commit」「rebase」「squash」，或问某段代码是谁写的、什么时候加进来的，就会接管。

say.text: 帮我把当前改动拆成几个原子提交
say.note: 会先打印风格检测和提交计划再执行

say.text: 用 rebase 把这个分支的历史整理干净
say.note: 本地未推送的提交会被重写

say.text: 这行代码是谁写的？什么时候加进来的？

howto.what_en: Handles git operations: first prints a repo commit-style detection, then splits changes into multiple atomic commits (3+ files must be split), and can also rewrite branch history (rebase/squash) or trace who/when introduced a change.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say "commit", "rebase", "squash", or ask who wrote a line or when a change was added.

say_en.text: Split my current changes into several atomic commits
say_en.note: Prints style detection and a commit plan first

say_en.text: Rebase this branch to clean up its history
Who wrote this line, and when was it added?
